name: JumpServer
description: JumpServer is an open-source PAM (Privileged Access Management) / bastion host that provides unified, audited access to SSH, RDP, VNC, Telnet, Kubernetes and database assets through a single web console, with full session recording and playback.

notes.text: The generated admin password is saved to ~/jumpserver.creds inside the container.

Upstream only ships JumpServer v5 as Docker images, so this script builds KoKo, Lina and Luna from source at the same tag as the core. Installs and updates take a long time and need the default resources.
The SSH bastion (character-protocol) endpoint is on port 2222, e.g. ssh -p 2222 <user>@<container-ip> — this is separate from the web console on port 80.
First start takes several minutes: the core service runs database migrations, downloads a GeoIP database, and installs built-in RDP applets on its own before the web UI becomes reachable.
